problem.semantics: Task window on full parent navigation; paths may leave window; no physical-map clipping

validation.scope: Original global roadmap, circular-base inflated AABB navigation, and proxy/externally supplied per-arm service tables; no built-in IK, arm swept path or joint trajectory certificate

targets.return_semantics: Undiscounted reward-to-go with signed terminal H correction; not physical remaining distance
targets.scope: Complete trace arithmetic only; no training or physical certification

timer_scope: Cold model, saved navigation input load, all provenance/preparation/provider/features/policy/H/export/validation; filesystem-cache state uncontrolled; record IO reported separately
timing_boundary: Already-prepared problem through both exports/validation, target and state packing; excludes caller input preparation, model loading and persistence
